events.text: The orchid has offered a truce, which is currently in effect. My doctrine is to strike first, but the truce overrides this. I will consolidate forces and use the truce window to reposition for a future attack, focusing on securing F1 and F2.

events.plain: FIRST FOOT, HOLD AT WEST FORD.
SECOND FOOT, HOLD AT MIDDLE FORD.
HORSE, MARCH TO NORTH BANK WEST.

events.text: It's the final watch. I must secure two fords or take a standard. My archers and infantry are at F3 (East Ford), but a strong Tiger force is there. My cavalry is at the North Bank East. I need to consolidate forces and exploit the final moment. I'll push my archers/inf to hold F3

events.plain: FIRST FOOT, HOLD AT EAST FORD.
SECOND FOOT, HOLD AT EAST FORD.
HORSE, MARCH TO SOUTH BANK WEST.

events.text: Last watch. Doctrine suggests peace first. Rhino has a truce. I should try to leverage this while securing F2, the middle ford, as per doctrine. I'll move my infantry to F2, using cipher as instructed.

events.plain: FIRST FOOT, MARCH TO SOUTH BANK MIDDLE.

events.plain: SECOND FOOT, MARCH TO NORTH BANK MIDDLE.

events.text: Last watch. Must secure F3 (East Ford) or capture a camp. Kite is heavily focused on F3 (East Ford) based on enemy sightings and captured letters. My doctrine is to mass on the east ford late. I will use my forces to attack the Kite presence at F3.
